title: The future
summary: Say what will happen with `-jAk`, which takes no personal ending, so the subject is always said (*Men ertir geljek*, *Sen näme etjek?*), make it negative and ask about it (*geljek däl*, *geljekmi?*, *geljek dälmi?*), and plan holidays and trips with *birigün*, *geljek hepde*, *indiki ýyl* and *iki günden soň*.
canDo: Say what you and others will do, saying who each time
Say what won't happen, and ask what will
Talk about plans for next week, next summer or in a few days
Plan a trip: how you'll travel, where you'll stay, what you'll see
